pr_title: Show event times in Sydney time

comments.comment: stamp returns a Sydney local-time string, which the base decision forbids: every API timestamp is a UTC ISO 8601 string ending in Z.
comments.failureScenario: The API returns events at 2026-10-30T21:00:00Z and 2026-10-31T22:00:00Z. The head stamps them `31/10/2026, 8:00:00 am` and `01/11/2026, 9:00:00 am`, with no `Z`. A client that sorts the strings as text, as the decision says clients do, puts the earlier event second.
